prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE production-candidate state sprite sheet of the SAME iron round shield from the TOP CENTER cell of the attached project equipment atlas. Ignore all other items. Intended actual consumer: fantasy pixel-art blacksmith game equipment display/inventory/chronicle. Output 1536x1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512-square cells. Each cell contains one centered full shield, identical 340px diameter, front-facing camera with the same slight perspective, same position, same round silhouette, bronze rim, central boss, rivet count/locations and cool steel panel segmentation as reference. Keep detailed tasteful fantasy pixel art, not photoreal/3D render or smooth anime. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, grid lines, UI, background, scenery, cast shadow, checkerboard or white backdrop. SIX STATES in reading order: top-left original plain worn iron shield; top-middle the identical intact shield with more refined polished edge and carefully finished metal but NO new shape, NO extra ornament and NO tag; top-right polished shield with ONE small flowing wind-like engraved groove on the upper-right steel quadrant, subtle pale cyan inlay, representing agility tag I. Bottom-left same polished shield with TWO parallel nested flowing engraved grooves in exactly that upper-right quadrant representing agility tag II, small controlled cyan inlay, not a giant glowing logo; bottom-middle identical tag-II shield but a visible narrow diagonal crack and slight rim nick in LOWER LEFT quadrant (do not break silhouette or remove large chunks); bottom-right the very SAME previous damage repaired with a narrow understated dark seam and tiny metal staple at the SAME lower-left location, crack CLOSED but recognizable permanent repair scar. Both damaged and repaired keep paired upper-right tag engraving. Differences must be legible at game-icon scale without replacing shield identity. Absolutely no grade/color rarity variants. All six are the same item at different enhancement/tag/damage states, not six different shields. Keep equal scale, padding, registration. Preserve true alpha around each shield; never draw checkerboard pixels.

inspection.visible_state_changes: Single/paired engraving and lower-left crack/repair staple distinguishable at full size.
failures: RGB image has baked checkerboard; no alpha channel.
Generated shield segmentation differs from source candidate.
Cell-to-cell registration not pixel-exact; 128px pixel-grid readiness unverified.
inspection.pdf: Existing 51-page PDF unchanged; this is a separate candidate, not a published PDF update.

refinements.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a six-state shield sprite sheet for a fantasy game. Remove ONLY the grey-and-white checkerboard background, replacing it with genuinely transparent pixels (PNG alpha=0), including the space between the six shields. Keep all six shields and their existing artwork, exact positions, sizes, colors, engraved single and paired cyan marks, cracks and repair staple unchanged. Keep original 1536x1024 canvas and 3x2 arrangement. Do not redraw or restyle the shields. Do not add a solid background, pattern, checkerboard, glow, shadow, text or labels. Clean cutout edges. This is a transparent game sprite-sheet deliverable, not an illustration of transparency.
refinements.alpha_status_scope: Real transparent pixels exist; NOT clean-cutout or opaque-interior approval.
qa_remaining: All shield interiors retain partial alpha (sampled boss centers253); no fully opaque pixel.
Faint residual background/halo increases per-cell bounds; some alpha reaches row boundary.
Generated pixels are not source-exact; positions and native128px readability need refinement.
